verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's own Query Assistant turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. Its official MCP server also lets AI agents query telemetry, investigate issues, and work with Boards, Triggers and SLOs from open-ended prompts, and a community user reports this working in practice. However, the in-product natural-language interface is documented only for query generation, and broader natural-language operation depends on an external MCP-capable agent. missing for 10: documented natural-language control within the product beyond query generation (e.g., creating or managing Boards, Triggers and SLOs by command without an external agent), and independent hands-on corroboration of Query Assistant's accuracy and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.
Even open-ended prompts like "Investigate latency in the `api-gateway` service" can be productive.
Reference for the tools Honeycomb MCP exposes to AI agents, including discovery, query, trace, Board, Trigger, SLO, and Canvas investigation tools.
